node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, can the source mug be identified in the edit, and where is that same mug relative to the headphones?
node.criteria: Assess the mug visible in the source, tracking its identity across the edit using visual features and scene context. Complete only if that same mug is to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Partial only if evidence establishes that the source mug itself moved toward the right but did not reach the right side. Absent if the source mug is identifiable and shows no progress toward the right. Unknown if identity or displacement cannot be established; do not count a newly added or duplicated mug on the right as progress.
